inclusion_rule: Setting (one definition for all three topics): human studies, any signal type in the wiki, that close a loop from recorded activity to a device or display with feedback (online, real-time or closed-loop BCI/BMI/neuroprosthesis) in a speech-related context. Design of interest: the user's control action is a speech task (overt, attempted, mimed or imagined phonemes, vowels, words) rather than limb movement or imagery, a non-speech cognitive task or an evoked-potential selection. Boundary: reviews, offline-only decoders and perception studies are excluded from the prior population; reports of the same experiment are counted once; ledger and full-text pattern counts are upper bounds; earlier BCIs missing from the wiki are taken from the target's own citations and labelled so.

read_fulltext.quote: 25% improvement in average hit rate (from 45% to 70%)
speech-related region of the left precentral gyrus
Generally, these have included hand movements, tongue movements, and articulation of single words
